privacy.display: Only compiler-authored shapes appear as SQL text. Every untrusted statement appears as untrusted statement <128-bit HMAC fingerprint>. No parser result or fallback raw text reaches diagnostics.

privacy.overflow: Shape or call-site overflow fails testkit and logs one incomplete warning per HTTP request; parse failure is not incompleteness because keyed raw fallback remains countable.
privacy.deleted: Public StatementShape and SQL-derived text display, utility labels, WITH/data-statement classification, setting-function display redaction, and Unshapable reporting. Internal grouping normalization is not a privacy boundary.

normalization.rules: Data statement whitelist: SELECT/INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE/MERGE/VALUES/TABLE. WITH prefixes are parsed recursively before classification; CTE bodies and main statement must resolve to the whitelist. Unsupported/malformed WITH grammar is Unshapable. Utility labels and setting-function argument redaction remain. VALUES and IN preserve ARRAY boundaries; only ANY operands unwrap. Literal list multiplicity collapses with ordered VALUES arity and cast signatures preserved.
normalization.failure: Unsupported/unterminated/oversized input marks Unshapable, retaining no original SQL. This includes unparsed WITH constructs, utility commands behind WITH, SEARCH/CYCLE, ambiguous backslash strings, Unicode-escaped identifiers, and all multi-statement strings regardless of their leading keyword.
normalization.overflow: New shapes beyond MaxShapes mark Overflow; existing shapes continue counting. Test assertion fails and HTTP logs one incomplete-observation warning per request.

benchmark.interpretation: Both disabled labels describe the same nil instrumentation path, not different implementations.
